Marissa —

We can support a temporary no-PO onboarding for trial/PO-exempt pilots if controls are satisfied. Minimum required from vendor:
1) W-9 on file (US vendors)
2) Signed trial addendum that includes liability and data handling clauses (vendor sent SLA draft; need legal review)
3) Single-invoice cap set below the non-PO threshold (we typically allow invoices <= $5,000 for trial exceptions)
4) Finance business code and GL account to route costs

Approvals needed: Procurement manager + Finance lead. Legal triage can be limited to a 1-hour review if we use our standard trial addendum template.

I can approve this conditionally if Finance confirms coding and Legal signs off on the SLA redlines by EOD 3/27.

-Priyom
Procurement Operations

Thanks — I reviewed. Quick decision log so CS/sales have clarity:

Decision: Approve temporary invoice-only onboarding for EdgeWorks trial under these conditions:
- Trial invoice exposure must be <= $5,000 total (estimated $3,200 meets this)
- W-9 must be on file (received)
- Legal to complete SLA triage / mark any nonstandard data clauses by 17:00 PT today
- Finance must provide GL/account coding and confirm they will accept invoice route for this vendor
- Exception duration: 90 days (30-day trial + 60-day window for PO conversion)

If any of the above fail, Procurement will pause onboarding until a PO is issued. Please notify vendor of conditional approval and required attachments.

Action items:
- Marissa: Send vendor the Redwood trial addendum (use one-click template) and request countersignature or acceptance of our changes.
- Priyom: Hold until Legal and Finance confirm; if both approve, mark vendor as "Invoice-only (temporary)" in Vendor Portal and set expiry date 2028-06-25.
- Laura: If Finance needs an override, please escalate to the Finance director with RDWD-5542 deal id.
